Class NitriteInternalKeys

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.data.nitrite.model.query.NitriteInternalKeys
@Internal public final class NitriteInternalKeys extends Object
Marker keys written into a built query by the Nitrite query builder and consumed again when the query is bound at runtime. Unlike NitriteQueryOperators these are not Nitrite operators: they never reach the store and exist only to carry binding metadata between build and execution.
Since:
5.2.0
